name: moberg-plugins
description: Moberg d.o.o. Claude Code plugins — the MTK engineering toolkit, the work-tree CLI (work / wd), the DocuMe docs lifecycle, and the agentic-coach session coach

plugins.name: mtk
plugins.description: MTK (Moberg Toolkit) — command entry points backed by reusable skills, review agents, and compliance-first workflows for teams building serious software across .NET, Python, and TypeScript

plugins.name: work-tree
plugins.description: Skills for the work-tree CLI — wd-review drives interactive `wd -c` browser diff reviews

plugins.name: docume
plugins.description: The generative half of the DocuMe docs lifecycle: write, refresh and correct a repo-based wiki that publishes to Confluence. Every skill's output is a pull request, and only the `docume` CLI talks to Confluence.

plugins.name: agentic-coach
plugins.description: Reads your own Claude Code sessions, scores eight working habits and builds a local, interactive coaching report with what to try next. Runs on your machine and uploads nothing.
